name: cursor
title: Custom Cursor
summary: CSS-only custom cursors for light and dark mode.
description: CSS-only custom cursors (no JS): SVG icons drawn by the browser as the real system cursor, light + dark versions switched by body[mode]. Automatic for links, buttons, text fields, disabled elements; manual with data-cursor="view|play|external|zoom-in|zoom-out|grab|move|crosshair|progress|not-allowed|…" or .cursor-<name>. Icons are CSS variables (--cursor-<name>).
